convert_dataset_to_webdataset: convert a CLIP_benchmark dataset to webdataset TAR format with configurable image format and shard size
convert_retrieval_dataset_to_webdataset: convert a retrieval dataset with image caption pairs to webdataset TAR format
run_cli_conversion: run the CLI tool to convert a named dataset split to webdataset format in an output directory
create_pil_to_bytes_transform: create a transform function that converts PIL images to bytes in webp png or jpg format
save_classnames_and_templates: save dataset classnames and zero-shot classification templates to text files in the output folder
